summary: Layout verification of /build on desktop (1440x900, 1280x720) and mobile (390x844, 360x640). Desktop split layout confirmed: builder-stage-column (left, flex 1) hosts header, type chips, builder-preview-canvas filling column height (912x677 at 1440; 752x497 at 1280) and caption; builder-options-panel on the right at 480px scrolls vertically with cards in a 3-col grid and bottom bar (builder-total-price + save-design-button) inside the panel. Studio photo (builder-render-photo) shows the whole ring without cropping (contentFit=contain with a blurred backdrop). Mobile: single column, canvas is square-ish (342x342 at 390w; 312x269 at 360w) and never crops the ring, option cards are compact (~136px) in a horizontal row, bottom bar does not overlap content. Regression checks passed: style change updates price ($7,041 -> $7,303), type chip switching works, 3D (live) toggle fills the desktop column and ring-3d-viewer renders, photo-fullscreen-button opens fullscreen viewer with fullscreen-photo, save-design-button triggers builder-toast 'Saved to your collection', and /design/[id] still renders DesignCanvas correctly (fixed 342x340 preview). One minor layout bug was found and fixed in this run: on mobile the builder-preview-caption was being flex-shrunk to ~1.6px (text hidden) because its parent flex column lacked remaining room; adding flexShrink:0 restored its intrinsic 15px height so the caption 'Style Type · Metal' is visible under the canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: build.tsx is 547 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting OptionCard, Section, and the panel into their own files if more sections are added.

In the desktop split, the type-chip ScrollView is still horizontal; on 1440 all four types fit without scrolling but the component uses ScrollView unconditionally. Not a bug, just a minor polish opportunity (could switch to a wrap on desktop).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build screen layout iteration verified. Desktop uses split column with builder-stage-column + builder-options-panel (480px); mobile stays single column with stageH = min(winW - 2*xl, winH*0.42). Caption flexShrink:0 fix landed in build.tsx. DesignCanvas renders with height prop on mobile and flex:1 on desktop/detail. All critical testIDs still present: builder-screen, builder-stage-column, builder-options-panel, builder-preview-canvas, builder-render-photo, canvas-mode-photo/live, photo-fullscreen-button, builder-total-price, save-design-button, builder-toast, type-chip-*, style-option-*, option-shape-*, option-band-*, size-option-*.
rca_of_issue: Caption clipping on mobile: canvasCaption Text was a direct child of the root flex column alongside a flex:1 KeyboardAwareScrollView; on narrow heights the browser applied the default flexShrink:1 to the Text node and compressed its height to ~1.6px with overflow:hidden. Fix: set flexShrink:0 on canvasCaption so the 15px intrinsic height is preserved.
